newsitem.title: USA: Vermont legislators to unveil property tax plan.
newsitem.headline: Vermont legislators to unveil property tax plan.

text.p: Democrats in the Vermont Legislature said they plan to disclose their property tax reform plan on Thursday.

Legislative sources, who declined to be named, said the plan would establish a base property tax at three-percent of family income plus an additional adjustment based on income. That adjustment could add or subtract from a taxpayer's bill.
The plan could also mean as much as a six-cent addition to the state's gasoline tax.
The Democrats proposal would aim to also preserve local autonomy while controlling education costs and establishing statewide property tax sharing to equalized tax rates among towns.
